podcast.title: Belief in Daughter's Involvement in Kurt Cobain's Death (Post-1994)
podcast.body: Hank Harrison, Courtney Love's biological father, publicly expressed his belief that his daughter "had anything to do with" Kurt Cobain's death. He stated she had "confessed to various aspects of it" in letters and interviews, and noted her financial benefit from the death. "Do you believe your daughter had anything to do with Kurt's death? Oh, sure."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Financial Motive Regarding Kurt Cobain (Post-1994)
podcast.body: Hank Harrison articulated a financial motive surrounding Kurt Cobain's death, stating that if Cobain had not died that weekend, he would have emptied bank funds and signed divorce papers and other contracts. This action, Harrison explained, would have financially cut out Courtney Love and "a lot of other people." "he would have gone to the bank and taken all the money out of the funds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Public Opinion on Reopening Cobain Case (1997)
podcast.body: Hank Harrison recalled being interviewed on the "Jane Houghton show" in Toronto in 1997. During this show, a survey indicated that approximately 95% of the listeners were interested in reopening the Kurt Cobain case and voted in favor of it, suggesting widespread public doubt about the official verdict. "about 95% of the people listening to the Jane Houghton show at that time where we're interested in reopening the case and voted that way, called in and voted that way."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Financial Gain from Death (Post-1994)
xref.body: Hank Harrison suggested that Courtney Love benefited significantly financially from Kurt Cobain's death. He claimed that under a prenuptial agreement, she would have received less, but after his death, she "got everything," and even the "baby's money is gone too." "whereas now she got everything and she now says that the baby's money is gone too."

xref.title: Financial Motive for Murder (Post-1994)
xref.body: Courtney Love's biological father, Hank Harrison, suggested a strong financial motive for Kurt Cobain's death. He posited that if Cobain had lived that weekend, he would have withdrawn all his money from bank funds, signed divorce papers, and other contracts, which would have significantly cut Courtney and other individuals out of substantial sums. "Kurt hadn't been chilled that weekend, he would have gone to the bank and taken all the money out of the funds."

xref.title: Hank Harrison's Allegations Against Courtney Love (Undated)
xref.body: Hank Harrison, Courtney Love's estranged biological father, asserted that his daughter was involved in Kurt Cobain's death. He claimed she had "written letters and had several interviews where she's confessed to various aspects of it." Harrison also suggested a clear financial motive, stating that if Kurt had lived, he would have withdrawn funds, signed divorce papers, and other contracts that would have significantly reduced Courtney's inheritance. He noted public sentiment, citing a 1997 Jane Houghton Show survey where approximately 95% of listeners voted to reopen the case. "Oh, sure. I mean, she's actually written letters and had several interviews where she's confessed to various aspects of it."
